# Zermind

> Zermind is an open-source AI conversation application that displays branching chats as interactive mind maps.

Canonical site: https://zermind.ai/
Source code: https://github.com/okikeSolutions/zermind
Publisher: okike Solutions e.U.
Contact: info@okike-solutions.com

## Public pages

- Home and product information: https://zermind.ai/
- Interactive demo: https://zermind.ai/demo
- AI model comparison demo: https://zermind.ai/demo/ai-comparison
- Creative writing demo: https://zermind.ai/demo/creative-writing
- Problem-solving demo: https://zermind.ai/demo/problem-solving
- Privacy policy: https://zermind.ai/privacy
- Terms of use: https://zermind.ai/terms
- Legal provider information: https://zermind.ai/imprint
- Sitemap: https://zermind.ai/sitemap.xml

## Product facts

- Conversations can branch from earlier messages.
- Mind Mode displays messages and branches as a visual tree.
- Users can configure their own API keys.
- Zermind supports direct AI-provider integrations and models available through OpenRouter.
- Public share links expose a conversation until the owner revokes the link or deletes the chat.
- Collaboration is a beta feature.
- Zermind is released under the MIT License.

Private account, chat, settings, and collaboration routes are not public documentation and should not be indexed.
